620.description: '''Urotsuki's Room''' is where the player starts the game. This room and its balcony are two of the only locations Urotsuki can access outside of her dreams.

622.name: Maple Shrine
622.description: The Maple Shrine is an area accessible from the Hand Hub and the Shinto Shrine. The portal to the Shinto Shrine has a small chance to take Urotsuki here, and each Torii gate in the Shinto Shrine may also teleport her here. Overall, the chance of being teleported here from either area, assuming Urotsuki passes through all seven Torii gates in the Shinto Shrine, is approximately 11.65%. If the current season is fall, it will be a 24.27% chance instead.

4100.name: Arctic

metadata.Name: Arashi no Kyokuchi, Storm at The Pole

4100.description: The Arctic is an area accessible from the Impossible Traincar.  ==Features== The Arctic is a large, dark area with a sparse distribution of rocks and trees. This location experiences a constant blizzard, making it hard to see. If Urotsuki stays outside for too long, it will progressively get brighter, the blizzard will slowly subside and the music will begin to slowly quiet down until it becomes silent. She will then collapse to the ground and stay still for a bit, before waking up. Using the Lantern or Spacesuit effect will provide a bit of light to illuminate the surroundings. The previously mentioned changes will still occur when the effects are equipped, however Urotsuki will not wake up.

4121.description: Disc Rot is an area accessible from a rusty screw in Theatre World.

4122.name: Rainbow Block Towers
4122.description: Rainbow Block Towers is an area accessible from Disc Rot. ==Features==  This area is characterized by its massive towers, dithered in ways that make them appear to have smooth gradients. Around the area are several paintings hanging off the walls, as well as neon signs. There are also directional arrows scattered randomly around the area, which often do not lead anywhere, frequently contradicting each other.
